data.name: Tower And Swords
data.detailed_description:
- 13 towers and monsters that appeared in the world one day.

This is a game that tells the story of a archer wiping out monsters in a tower for peace in the world.

Bowsmen gain new weapons and magic, enhance special abilities, and become stronger.

And then kill the strong monsters one after another.

- This is a game where you adventure through the tower, grow, and ultimately defeat the devil.

You can obtain various equipment, potions, and magic stones at the tower.

You must defeat all powerful tower owners and restore peace to the world.

By defeating the tower owner, you can obtain a stronger weapon.

- You can obtain a variety of equipment from the tower, from regular equipment to legendary equipment.

You can obtain high-grade equipment by defeating the gatekeeper monster guarding the entrance to the next floor and the tower owner monster.

The drop rate of high-grade equipment that can be obtained from gatekeeper monsters and tower owners is cumulative and can be obtained unconditionally if you catch it repeatedly.

(The drop rate can be checked in the tower information in the portal.)

- Items of rare grade or higher have additional options.

Options can range from increased stamina to increased movement speed to reduced magic cooldown.

- Every bow contains mysterious magic.

Gatekeeper monsters and tower owner monsters can obtain special and legendary swords that are higher than rare, and these bows contain powerful unique magic.

- You can obtain equipment with various abilities, grow, and ultimately tailor the equipment to the desired abilities.

- You can gain many abilities through artifacts.

Artifacts can be strengthened with materials purchased through jams and obtained through game progression.

- You can purchase and obtain a archer costume.

Additional abilities are applied simply by owning the archer costume. Some costumes can be purchased or obtained through game progression.

- As your archer character grows and levels up, you can strengthen various passive spells with points earned.

- Adventure the tower, obtain powerful equipment, and grow your character.

- It is not an idle game, but a single-player game in a package format with an end.

You can go on a journey not only of matching items, but also of defeating the dark lord in the end.

After that, you can continue playing a little more by advancing to the challenge difficulty level.

- You can play without any restrictions even in an environment without internet.

I hope you have fun playing.

Thank you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
